name: Thomas
summary: One of the twelve apostles, also called Didymus. He would not believe Jesus had risen until he saw Him, and then he called Jesus his Lord and his God.

key_moments.title: Offers to Die with Jesus
key_moments.description: When Jesus decided to go back to Judaea, where people had tried to stone Him, Thomas told the other disciples they should go too, even to die with Him.

key_moments.title: Asks Jesus the Way
key_moments.description: Thomas told Jesus they did not know where He was going or the way there. Jesus answered that He is the way, and no one comes to the Father except through Him.

key_moments.title: Believes After Seeing Jesus
key_moments.description: Thomas said he would not believe unless he saw the nail marks in Jesus' hands. Eight days later Jesus came, told him to look at His hands and touch His side, and Thomas called Him his Lord and his God.
